string.text: Oh, look at this, an army boy who knows his trigger discipline! How come you haven't tried to gun me down yet?? Well.. Speak up!!

Curb your enthusiasm, stalker, I'm the... Just a trader. You can call me a military trader if you wish. Who I really am is none of your concern... Now look here, I'm not really interested in your relationship with the military and other stalker clans, so spare me the headache, alright? I'm just here to trade supplies and equipment with the military, they tolerate me because for them it's good business to offload excess frags and spare mags for some booze money. Oh yeah, one more thing, you may meet other traders like me around, so don't be afraid to chat with them but keep your finger off the trigger! Well, what are you staring at, are we gonna to do business or what?
Alright, let's get down to business.
Hi man, you must be one of the local "traders", right?

Well... If you want to put it that way, then "yes". They call me Profiteer. I'm selling weapons, equipment, anything my mates bring to me really. Don't be confused with my neutrality - I'm just a trader, I don't pick sides. As for my buddies around here... They're just here to protect me, and in return I throw a little something their way, everyone's happy. Got it? So, are you in? Trade what you want, and get out of here. I don't wanna see your funny face just for chit-chat, you're stinking up the place.
Listen, can you tell me how to get to the Wild Territory from here?
The best way to the Wild Territory is through the Dead City, I'll send the coordinates to your PDA. A lot of mercs are holed up there, so beware of their snipers, they don't fire warning shots!

Hi yourself, goner. I am not a mercenary and you know it, and if you don't - then go over to my ... Uhh ... colleagues, and they will explain it to you. I offer some of their gear though, surplus stuff mostly. Are you interested in something, stalker?

Hey, so you've been around these parts for a while, right? I bet you know the area real well! Can you suggest any shortcuts from the Radar to the southern parts of the Zone? I'm tired of pushing through the Army base all the time, as you know it's not the pleasant walk in the park it used to be...

Sure, I can give you a few pointers, it's in my best interest to keep prospective customers alive and happy, heh, heh! So basically, there are two decent paths to the southern areas: the one towards the East will lead you to the Dark Valley, and the Western path leads to Yantar - dangerous place there, so stay sharp! By the way, if you see Profiteer, give him my regards!
I didn't realize Monolith had its own traders?

You are only partially correct, stalker. I trade all sorts of gear and supplies with the Monolithians, but I'm not one of them. Now, you're probably curious how it came to be that I was permitted to stay here and didn't get killed on sight, right? Don't ask, trust me.. Just a hint: these Monolith followers are not quite the "fanatics" that they seem. They just have their own ... patrons, is all.
And what about the Brain Scorcher? The radar antennae are just down the road from here!

I have this special helmet from my "friends" among the "big wigs" here. Don't go trying anything funny though - it will self-destruct as soon as you try to remove it, most likely tearing off your hands in the process. Oh, believe me, these "friends" of mine know how to defend their technology. By the way, my ... employer... has asked me to tell you that you should be careful near the reactor. He may contact you himself in the future, but for now he asked me to convey his message to you: "Not everything that seems obvious to us is obvious indeed"...
Man, you traders really make me laugh, you'll infiltrate your way into any place, no matter how fucked up it is! I'm at a loss for words at this point!
